spec2def(clb.dll clb.spec)

# clb.dll is all Rust (clb-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/clb-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# clb.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/clb-rust/src/clb/clb.rs)
add_cargo_module(clb clb-cargo clb.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE clb-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
